mechanism_narrative: An increase in the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) above 2.5% annualized over the previous 3 months signals inflationary pressure, leading to tighter monetary policy expectations and negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or CPIAUCSL annualized growth does not correlate with FEDFUNDS changes (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in the unemployment rate (UNRATE) by more than 0.5% over the previous 3 months signals a tightening labor market, boosting corporate earnings and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 60d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or UNRATE decrease does not correlate with PAYEMS increase (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: An increase in housing starts (HOUST) by more than 5% over the previous 2 months signals increased economic activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or HOUST increase does not correlate with RSAFS increase (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: A decrease in industrial production (INDPRO) by more than 2% over the previous 3 months signals a contraction in supply, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 20d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or INDPRO decrease does not correlate with GDPC1 decrease (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is above 2% and the GDP (GDPC1) growth rate is below 2% annually, it signals a monetary tightening cycle with weak economic growth, leading to negative S&P 500 forward returns over the next 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces positive 60d returns in > 60% of triggered instances despite the negative signal, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in a multivariate regression model).

mechanism_narrative: When the unemployment rate (UNRATE) is below 4% and nonfarm payrolls (PAYEMS) increase by more than 200,000 over the previous month, it signals a strong labor market, boosting consumer spending and leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 40% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in a multivariate regression model).

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in real personal consumption expenditures (RSAFS) over the previous 3 months signals strong consumer demand, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 20d returns in > 50% of instances despite the positive signal, or RSAFS increase does not correlate with SPX returns (Pearson r < 0.3).

mechanism_narrative: When the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) is below 1% and the Consumer Price Index (CPIAUCSL) is above 2% annualized, it signals accommodative monetary policy with inflationary pressure, leading to positive S&P 500 forward returns over the next 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX produces negative 5d returns in > 50% of triggered instances despite the positive signal, or the interaction effect is not significant (p > 0.05 in a multivariate regression model).
